column4: Pixel-art game sprite in the style of 1990s Build-engine games (Duke Nukem 3D, Redneck Rampage): chunky visible pixels, a limited muted palette, strong simple shading, a single object in the centre, full size, readable as a tiny icon. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no ground shadow, no floor, no text, no letters, no border, no watermark. A black plastic rubbish bag, knotted at the top, bulging, with an empty beer can lying beside it.
